title: Video Production in Indianapolis | Vertical Studios
description: Brand films, testimonials, service explainers, event recaps and short-form social cuts. We concept, script, shoot and edit, start to finish.

blocks.headline: People buy from businesses they've seen
blocks.body: And heard. We handle video end to end: concepting, scripting, shooting and editing. Brand films, testimonials, service explainers, event recaps and short-form social cuts.

blocks.heading: What we produce
blocks.body: Five formats. Each one has a job to do.

items.title: Brand films
items.body: Who you are and why you do the work. A piece you can use on your homepage, in pitches and at events.

items.title: Testimonials
items.body: Your clients, in their own words, on camera. We handle the questions so they sound like themselves.

items.title: Service explainers
items.body: What you do and how it works, explained plainly. Answers to the questions prospects ask before they call.

items.title: Event recaps
items.body: Capture the day for the people who were there. Give everyone else a reason to come next time.

items.title: Short-form social cuts
items.body: Short clips sized for social feeds, cut from a larger shoot or filmed on their own. We run monthly film days for Vertical Life.

blocks.heading: From idea to final cut
blocks.body: We handle it end to end. You show up for the parts that need you.
items: Intro call: a short conversation about what you want people to see, hear and do.
What winning looks like: the one thing this video needs to accomplish, and where it will live.
Concept and script: we write it, plan the shoot and share it with you before cameras roll.
Shoot and edit: our crew films, edits and delivers cuts for every place you'll use them.

blocks.heading: Who's behind the camera
blocks.body:
A senior lead owns the concept and the message. Our creative director reviews the work before it goes out.

Noah Bales, a Vertical Immersive alum, supports shoot prep, on-set work and the final edit. Apprentices join the crew under direct supervision.
blocks.imageAlt: Noah Bales, Video Production at Vertical Studios

items.question: Do you write the script?
items.answer: Yes. Concepting and scripting are part of the work. You review the script before we shoot.

items.question: Can one shoot cover several videos?
items.answer: Often, yes. One well-planned day can produce a brand film, a testimonial and short-form cuts. We'll tell you when that makes sense.

items.question: What does a video cost, and how long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on scope: the format, the locations and how many cuts you need. Every engagement is custom and starts with a short call. [Book a call](/book-a-call).

items.question: Where do you film?
items.answer: We're based at the Atrium in Indianapolis. Where we shoot depends on the story, and we plan locations together during scripting.

blocks.heading: Put your story on camera
blocks.body: Tell us what you want people to see. Gabe will set up a short call.
